result.stdout:
Usage: runic-translations generate [options]

Generate translation artifacts.

With no --emit-* option, renders C#, locale-v5 JSON with its asset manifest, and
ESM. With any, renders only the selected groups.

Exit codes: 0 success; 1 command failure, such as a verify difference or an
inaccessible file; 2 invalid invocation or translation diagnostics; 3 internal
failure; 130 cancelled.

Options:
  --project <directory>  Translations directory or its runic.json. Defaults to
                         ./runic.json, then ./translations/runic.json.
  --output <directory>   Directory to write the artifacts to. [required]
  --emit-csharp          Render the typed C# API.
  --emit-json            Render locale-v5 JSON and its asset manifest.
  --emit-esm             Render the ESM package and web-module-manifest-v3.json.
  -h, --help             Show help
  --version              Show version
  --format <human|json>  Select output format
  @<file>                Read more arguments from a file

Examples:
  runic-translations generate --output obj/translations --emit-esm

result.stdout:
Usage: runic-translations import-text [options]

Import a text-keyed catalog into an RMF2 group.

Generates stable keys from the base texts, writes
<project>/<group>/<locale>.rmf2 and <project>/<group>/base-text.json, then
validates the project. A re-import keeps the key of every base text that is
still present.

Exit codes: 0 success; 1 command failure, such as a verify difference or an
inaccessible file; 2 invalid invocation or translation diagnostics; 3 internal
failure; 130 cancelled.

Options:
  --project <directory>     Translations directory or its runic.json. Defaults
                            to ./runic.json, then ./translations/runic.json.
  --group <name>            RMF2 group, written to <group>/. [required]
  --table <locale=path...>  JSON object mapping base text to translated text for
                            a declared locale; repeatable.
  --base <path>             JSON array of base texts that have no translation
                            yet.
  --dry-run                 Report the files without writing them.
  -h, --help                Show help
  --version                 Show version
  --format <human|json>     Select output format
  @<file>                   Read more arguments from a file

Examples:
  runic-translations import-text --group stored --table de=locales/de.json
  runic-translations import-text --project translations --group stored --base locales/untranslated.json --table de=locales/de.json --dry-run

result.stdout:
Usage: runic-translations init [options]

Create an RMF2 translation project and starter resources.

Writes runic.json and one .rmf2 file per locale into a new or empty directory.

Options:
  --directory <directory>    Directory to create the project in. [required]
  --catalog <catalog>        Portable catalog identifier. [required]
  --default-locale <locale>  Base locale tag, such as en. [required]
  --namespace <namespace>    Namespace of the generated C# API. [required]
  --class-name <name>        Class name of the generated C# API. [required]
  --locale <locale...>       Additional locale as <tag> or <tag>:<fallback>;
                             repeatable.
  --no-starter               Create the files without the starter message.
  -h, --help                 Show help
  --version                  Show version
  --format <human|json>      Select output format
  @<file>                    Read more arguments from a file

Examples:
  runic-translations init --directory translations --catalog app --default-locale en --locale de --namespace MyApp --class-name AppText

Renders in memory and compares byte for byte with --output, including extra
files. With no --emit-* option, renders C#, locale-v5 JSON with its asset
manifest, and ESM. With any, renders only the selected groups.

Exit codes: 0 success; 1 command failure, such as a verify difference or an
inaccessible file; 2 invalid invocation or translation diagnostics; 3 internal
failure; 130 cancelled.

Options:
  --project <directory>  Translations directory or its runic.json. Defaults to
                         ./runic.json, then ./translations/runic.json.
  --output <directory>   Directory with the artifacts to compare. [required]
  --emit-csharp          Compare the typed C# API.
  --emit-json            Compare locale-v5 JSON and its asset manifest.
  --emit-esm             Compare the ESM package and
                         web-module-manifest-v3.json.
  -h, --help             Show help
  --version              Show version
  --format <human|json>  Select output format
  @<file>                Read more arguments from a file

Examples:
  runic-translations verify --output obj/translations --emit-esm
